name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a junior silver and gold explorer focused on its flagship Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. The company is advancing toward a construction decision on the Diablillos silver-gold deposit, which holds a measured and indicated resource of 102.0 Mt grading 65 g/t Ag and 0.62 g/t Au. AbraSilver is in the late development stage, having received approval under Argentina's RIGI investment regime in early 2026 and targeting a final construction decision in the second half of 2026.
